'''Tryla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] during the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Tryla was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Assigned to an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate Clan]], Tryla was interested to hear stories of the mysterious [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="YOUNG" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Tryla and a group of fellow students, including [[Cryle]] and [[Ammon]], accompanied [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a training [[Mission to unidentified planet (Younglings)|mission]] to a jungle [[Unidentified planet (Younglings)|planet]].<ref name="YOUNG" />
